Messages.Author: Uriel
Messages.Body:
Hi,
I wanted to ask a few questions about Tournaments, Demo events and
possible changes:
1) The organizer can also be a judge? Can an organizer (as the judge)
participate in a tournament with multi-judge system?
2) Is the restriction on the number of players going to change
(allawing 6,7 and 11 players)? If yes, are tables with 6 and 7 players
eligible for multi-judge system?
3) Can an official tournament or Demo take place in a private location
(e.g. my house)? If a location of a tournament changes, can the new
one be private?
4) What resaults excactly should be submitted after a demo?
5) Is Demo and Praize Support subject to taxing by the Regulatory
Agency (if anyone has experience from Greece or EU, in general)? Are
they sent to the organizer or place that the tournament takes place?

Thanks for the help,
Aris

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Uriel wrote:
>
> Hi,
> I wanted to ask a few questions about Tournaments, Demo events and
> possible changes:
> 1) The organizer can also be a judge? Can an organizer (as the judge)
> participate in a tournament with multi-judge system?

Yes. [VEKN 1.1] [VEKN 2.9]

> 2) Is the restriction on the number of players going to change
> (allawing 6,7 and 11 players)? If yes, are tables with 6 and 7 players
> eligible for multi-judge system?

Table sizes are still restricted to 4s and 5s. [VEKN 3.1.2]

> 3) Can an official tournament or Demo take place in a private location
> (e.g. my house)? If a location of a tournament changes, can the new
> one be private?

"Official" demo is not a meaningful distinction.
So long as the tournament venue is open to the public, sure.
"Private" tournaments are not generally sanctioned (save for
special events like the continental championships, which are
invitation-only). [VEKN 1.1]

> 4) What resaults excactly should be submitted after a demo?

The number of new players, the format used, and comments about
the "success" of the demo.

> 5) Is Demo and Praize Support subject to taxing by the Regulatory
> Agency (if anyone has experience from Greece or EU, in general)? Are
> they sent to the organizer or place that the tournament takes place?

Unknown. Coordinate that with the product support person.
http://www.white-wolf.com/vtes/veknPrizeSupport.html
